glosses: to draw, to sketch (to depict with lines; to produce a picture with pencil, crayon, chalk, etc., on paper, cardboard, etc.)
to draw on oneself, to sketch on oneself (to cover oneself with lines from a pencil, crayon, chalk, etc.)
to draw for a while, to sketch for some time
to draw on (to cover something with lines from a pencil, crayon, chalk, etc.)
to draw on each other, to sketch on each other; to be drawn on, to be sketched on
